messages:
maya: Hey — PR #32501 is blocked by CI. integration-suite snapshot failed on `session-cache` assertion after a tiny timing diff. This was green earlier today. Can someone either approve the snapshot update or kick a targeted rerun? :wave:

kevin: Can you paste the failing snippet? is it a legit diff or just order/timing noise?

maya: here's the relevant part from the job log:
```
AssertionError: expected snapshot to match
- last_active: 2026-03-17T11:22:01Z
+ last_active: 2026-03-17T11:22:02Z
 at tests/integration/session_cache.test.ts:142
```
Seems like a 1s drift in `last_active` formatting. Looks nondeterministic to me.

jen: If it's only timestamp drift we should avoid updating snapshot. Can we add a normalization in the test instead?

maya: agree; I'll open a small fix. But we still need to unblock the merge for others — can someone run a targeted rerun for pool-integ-3? CI is currently flaky and rerun helps. @alan any chance you can press the rerun?

alan: I can kick it. Waiting for green to do a merge. Triggering targeted rerun now. :gear:

ci-bot: buildkite: Rebuild requested by alan — https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/integration/1234 (targeted rerun on shard 3)

kevin: thanks. Also FYI, I've seen this pattern before — the serializer sometimes includes ms that get rounded differently on linux vs mac workers. If the fix will take >30m, it's fine to rerun once and then revert if it flaps.

maya: good note. I'll prioritize the normalization fix but won't block this merge for more than an hour. If rerun fails, I'll post a quick patch for the test and ask for a snapshot hold.

ci-bot: buildkite: Build finished — 1 failed, 1 succeeded (shard 3 succeeded on rerun).

alan: shard 3 passed, overall still showing 1 failure on shard 6 (unrelated tests). I'm going to requeue that shard as well.

jen: pinging @eng-oncall — can we get eyes on shard 6 flakes later if they persist?

maya: thanks everyone. I'll open the PR with timestamp normalization and add a short note in the PR description about the transient snapshot diff. If anyone wants to approve the transient snapshot update in the meantime, please comment on PR #32501. :thumbsup:

kevin: acked — will take a look in 15m.

maya: update — I pushed a tiny test change that trims `last_active` to seconds before snapshot. Running CI again.

ci-bot: buildkite: Rebuild queued by maya — https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/pipelines/integration/1235

maya: if the CI is flaky after the fix, we'll open a short-lived revert and follow up in the weekly flake triage. Thanks all.
